scenarios.expected: The intended account reaches its permitted landing page; two-factor and session controls have their documented effects. Expired activation, incorrect password/code, and revoked-session behavior are observable without exposing another account.
scenarios.actual: Newly invited legal_team_member account: the expired activation link was refused with This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.; the Administrator's resend delivered a fresh Set your OpenLaw password email; a password mismatch was refused; Password set offered Sign in; a wrong password was refused with Check your email and password.; the correct password reached Home with the account name in the header; the consumed link was refused. Settings > Profile > Turn on two-factor asked for the password, showed the QR code and manual secret, accepted the current code, showed ten backup codes once, and Profile then offered Re-enroll and Turn off two-factor. The sign-in challenge refused a wrong code and accepted the current code; a backup code worked once and its replay was refused; Sign out other devices from a second browser returned the first browser to sign-in on reload while the second stayed open; Re-enroll issued a different secret; Turn off two-factor required the password and password-only sign-in reached Home; Sign out returned to the sign-in page. In oidc mode with no provider the page said Single sign-on is not configured yet. Use administrator sign-in. with no Continue with single sign-on button; Nadia's password sign-in through Administrator sign-in was refused with Password sign-in is disabled while single sign-on is required.
